test_results.GOVERNANCE_SETTINGS_CARD: PASS - all testids present (gov-digest-day, gov-escalation-mult, gov-sla-urgent/high/hours/low, gov-oncall, gov-escalation-to, gov-digest-recipients, gov-digest-enabled, gov-save). test_results.PUBLIC_ROOM_CREATE: PASS - auditor-room-create-btn produced room token Vl-A0AW_ELxz75xZhU1Ztg, latest URL rendered in auditor-room-latest-url.
test_results.EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_CHECK: PASS - audit-room-verify click produced green audit-room-integrity-ok badge 'Untampered · c3048a41a345' on live (untampered) snapshot as expected.
test_results.PRIORITY_QUESTION_PUBLIC: PASS - audit-room-q-priority is a native <select>; set to 'urgent', filled name/email/text and submitted -> audit-room-question-sent visible. Admin Defensibility Auditor questions card shows new URGENT pill (question id Vw1awS762n3N).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: revoke() uses native window.confirm() which cannot be intercepted by Playwright's page.on('dialog') when clicking via force=True in some cases (had to override window.confirm via evaluate). Consider using an in-app confirm modal with a data-testid for better testability.
seed_data_creation: Created & revoked one auditor room (Vl-A0AW_ELxz75xZhU1Ztg). Created one URGENT auditor question (id Vw1awS762n3N) then admin-overrode to HIGH; left in place (task said leave test question as-is). Subscribed digest@example.com to weekly summary (stored only; no email fired). Governance restored to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 features rendering and wired correctly against live backend. If future test creates an auditor room, override window.confirm via page.evaluate('() => { window.confirm = () => true; }') before clicking auditor-room-revoke-<token> for reliable cleanup, or scroll into view + non-force click.
